entities.name: Lucius Aemilius Paullus Macedonicus

entities.summary: Lucius Aemilius Paullus Macedonicus was a consul of the Roman Republic, as well as a general, who conquered the Antigonid kingdom of Macedon during the Third Macedonian War.
